narrative.overview:
Farm is a command center for platform engineering. Every screen communicates competence through clarity: exact spacing, deliberate color, predictable interactions. It feels like a tool built by engineers for engineers — confident enough to be quiet.

The system rejects decorative flourishes. Cards have no side-stripe borders. Gradients are reserved for the login brand panel — never on UI chrome. The purple primary (Signal Violet) appears sparingly: active nav states, primary buttons, interactive focus rings. Its rarity is the point.
keyCharacteristics: Clean authority — information-rich but never dense; hierarchy guides the eye
Skeuomorphic restraint — flat surfaces at rest, subtle shadow on hover
One typeface does the work — Nunito from heading to caption, differentiated by weight and size
Dark mode is not an afterthought — every token is explicitly remapped, not inverted

rules.name: The One Voice Rule
rules.body: Signal Violet is the only interaction color. Never introduce a second accent for buttons, links, or focus states. Rose supports the brand gradient but does not compete as an interaction color.

rules.name: The Flat-At-Rest Rule
rules.body: Surfaces carry no shadow in their default state. Depth appears only as a response to interaction (hover, focus, elevated overlay).

rules.name: The One Size Rule
rules.body: Body text is always 0.875rem (text-sm). Secondary text is always 0.75rem (text-xs). There is no medium body size at 1rem — that slot belongs to titles only.

rules.name: The Flat-By-Default Rule
rules.body: A surface at rest has no shadow. If a card, sidebar, or panel needs visual separation from its background, use tonal layering (contrasting background color) — never a resting shadow.

dos: Use Signal Violet sparingly — active nav, primary buttons, focus rings. Its rarity is what makes it meaningful.
Keep body text at 0.875rem (text-sm) and secondary text at 0.75rem (text-xs). The hierarchy is two steps, not a ladder.
Use tonal layering (card on background, sidebar on background) instead of shadows for surface separation at rest.
Respect dark mode as a first-class state with explicitly remapped tokens.
Use `data-slot` attributes for targeting elements in tests and variants.
Use OKLCH for all color values. The existing palette is the source of truth.
Use `focus-visible` rings on all interactive elements. Never remove browser default focus without replacing it.
Cap content width at 65–75ch for readable prose.
donts: Use side-stripe borders (border-left greater than 1px as a colored accent). Use full borders or background tints instead.
Use gradient text (background-clip: text with a gradient). Emphasis comes from weight and size, not decoration.
Add glassmorphism or backdrop blur as a decorative default — reserved for modal backdrops only.
Write 999 or 9999 z-index values. Use the semantic scale: dropdown (50) → sticky (100) → modal-backdrop (49) → modal (50) → toast (60) → tooltip (70).
Replicate Backstage's dense, text-heavy sidebar or nested card grids. Farm is cleaner and more spacious.
Apply the brand gradient outside the login panel. The brand gradient is not a UI element.
Use uppercase tracking (eyebrow labels) on every section. The nav section labels are uppercase; content sections should not be.
Use cards nested inside cards. Cards are a single surface layer.
Animate layout properties (width, height, position) — prefer transform and opacity transitions.
